messages:
Anya: Heads-up — scheduling the weekend release wave for Saturday 02:00 UTC. Scope: model-serving v2 (canary), runtime optimizations, small DB migration (non-blocking), cache TTL rollout. Need smoke owners and rollback leads. Ping if you have blockers or need to shift.
Marco: I can own model-serving v2 canary. CI + evals green on staging. Plan to start canary at 02:00, smoke at 02:15 UTC. @sre-oncall please FYI.
Helen: I’ll take runtime optimizations smoke. Quick note: perf run showed a ~5% p95 bump for long sequences in staging — I’ll prep mitigation toggles and a short perf script.
Samir: DB migration is an add-column no-op (backfilled async). I’ll supervise and keep backups. Snapshot + pg_dump at 01:30 UTC.
Nathan: I’ll own feature-flag toggles and monitoring hooks. Flag CLI for rollback: `rflags set model_v2_enabled=false --env=prod` — make sure ops keys are loaded.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: model-serving v2 by Marco at 02:00 UTC (canary).
sre-oncall: @Marco @Helen please post smoke run links + trace IDs once started. I’ll monitor infra metrics and have rollback playbook ready.
Marco: Canary rollout plan: us-west-1 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 with weights 2% / 10% / 20%. Rollback command (ops-only): `/rollout rollback model-serving v2 --force` — documented in runbook.
Anya: Thanks. Assigning smoke owners: model = Marco, runtime = Helen, db = Samir. Rollback leads: Marco & Helen. I’ll update the release-train doc and Slack pinned note.
Marco: Post-deploy smoke checklist I’ll run and paste results: 1) baseline 100 rps sanity; 2) p95 < 300ms; 3) sample prompt sanity (10 queries); 4) error-rate < 0.5%.
Helen: Emergency mitigation toggle: `ENABLE_KV_CACHE=false` (env). I’ll keep the change ready in infra param store.
Samir: DB fallback script at infra/db/migrations/2143_rollback.sql — path in repo. If anything, run `psql -f infra/db/migrations/2143_rollback.sql` and then restore snapshot.
Nathan: I’ll add a prometheus alert for post-deploy: `alert: ModelServingErrorsHigh` (expr: rate(model_http_errors[5m]) > 0.05) and an oncall runbook link.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 30 minutes.
Zara: I’m OOO but reachable by phone for escalation (+1). Won’t be doing hands-on.
Anya: Perfect. Marco/Helen/Samir — please post smoke results and any anomaly logs here. If no objections by 01:45 UTC I’ll mark the slot locked. :white_check_mark:
Marco: No objections. I’ll paste smoke outputs after checks.
Helen: Likewise. I’ll also post the perf script cmd: `k6 run perf/canary_long_seq.js --vus 50 --duration 2m` — will share graphs.
sre-oncall: LGTM from oncall side. I’ll keep dashboards open and escalate if alerts fire.
Anya: Thanks team — I’ll update the release calendar and pin the post. Good luck, and ping here for any last-minute shifts.
